title: Bulk article API cost: Claude vs OpenAI vs DeepSeek
note: Rates per 1M tokens (input/output) checked November 2026: Claude Sonnet 5.5 $2/$10, OpenAI GPT-6.1 Sol $2/$10, GPT-4o (older model) $2.50/$10, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash $0.30/$1.20 at peak (half price off-peak). Assumes 1,500 prompt tokens per article and about 1.33 tokens per word; tokenizers differ. Batch processing (50% off at the major providers) and prompt caching lower real bills.

title: Make vs Zapier cost by workflow volume
note: Entry tiers checked November 2026 on annual billing: Make Core $9 for 10,000 credits; Zapier Professional $19.99 for 750 tasks and $49 for 2,000. Higher tiers are approximations because published ladders differ between sources, and monthly billing costs more on both. Both count each step; Zapier does not count the trigger, so Zapier may be overstated.

title: n8n self-hosted VPS vs n8n Cloud
note: n8n Cloud Starter is 24 euros a month billed monthly (20 annual) for 2,500 executions, Pro 60 (50 annual) for 10,000, and Business about 800 for 40,000 (sources differ). n8n bills in euros; figures are shown as dollars for simplicity. Self-hosted uses Hostinger KVM 2 at its $14.99 renewal rate (introductory $8.99) plus your time at $25 per hour, which is an assumption.

title: AI voice agent cost per minute
note: All-in per-minute estimates from published 2026 rates: Vapi has a $0.05 platform fee plus pass-through providers (typical all-in $0.13 to $0.30; $0.15 used), Retell about $0.115 (estimator: LLM $0.045, voice infrastructure $0.055, text-to-speech $0.015), Bland about $0.14. Phone charges are extra on most platforms.

title: AI coding editor monthly cost with extra usage
note: Seat prices checked November 2026: Cursor Pro $20, Windsurf Pro $20 (older Pro plans were $15), GitHub Copilot Pro $10 and Business $19. Copilot moved to usage-based AI credits on June 1, 2026 (1 credit = $0.01), so extra usage is modelled as dollars per seat for every tool. Team plans cost more (Cursor Teams $40 per seat).

inputs.label: Extra usage beyond included credits ($ per seat)

title: Faceless YouTube channel: AI stack vs freelancers
note: Claude Pro $20 and ElevenLabs Creator $22 (about 2 hours of audio) or Pro $99 are published prices checked November 2026. The video editing tool cost, the per-minute rendering cost and the freelancer rate of $6 per finished minute are assumptions; replace them with your own.

title: Knowledge base storage and query cost
note: Pinecone Standard has a $50 monthly minimum, then $0.33 per GB of storage and $16 to $18 per million read units (Pinecone pricing, checked October 2026). The calculator assumes about 6 KB per 1,536-dimension chunk and about 10 read units per query, so real read units depend on index size. Supabase Pro is $25 a month with 8 GB of database and a $10 compute credit, extra disk at $0.125 per GB, and no per-query charge, assuming the included Micro compute is enough. Self-hosted uses Hostinger KVM 2 at its $14.99 renewal rate. Reported Pinecone bills often exceed early estimates.

title: Cost to track brand prompts in AI engines
note: Otterly Lite $29 (15 prompts), Standard $189 (100), Premium $489 (400), extra 100 prompts $99; Peec Starter $95 (50 prompts), Pro $245 (150), Advanced $495 (350). Checked October to November 2026, billed monthly. Beyond the top published tier the calculator uses each vendor's add-on or top-tier cost per prompt. Profound ($99, ChatGPT only) is not modelled. Engine add-ons and annual discounts change totals.

title: AI visibility tracker cost over a test period
note: Monthly prices checked November 2026: Rankscale Pro $99, Pro+ $229 (Growth $385); SE Ranking Core $129 plus the $89 AI Search add-on ($218; sources differ, and an annual add-on price of $71.20 is also listed); SE Visible Basic $79. Allowances differ by plan, so this compares plan prices over time, not cost per prompt. Rankscale listed a 20-euro entry plan earlier in 2026, which may no longer exist.

inputs.label: Months you will run the tracker

title: AirOps tasks vs freelance writers
note: AirOps lists a free plan with 1,000 tasks a month, paid plans from $49 a month, and extra tasks at $9 per 1,000 on Pro ($6 on Team), per 2026 third-party reviews with moderate confidence; the task allowance of the $49 plan is assumed to be 1,000 and AirOps otherwise quotes custom pricing. Tasks per article depend on your workflow. The $40 freelance rate per article is an assumption.

title: AI visibility and indexing platform cost by team seats
note: AIclicks Starter $59 a month (choose 3 of 11 AI engines) with $189 and $499 tiers, observed May 2026; older directories list legacy prices of $39 and $79. Indexly now prices per user: Starter $99 (technical SEO indexing tools plus ChatGPT tracking of 50 prompts) and Growth $299, with a 17% annual discount, read May 2026; older directories still list indexing-only plans from $14 to $59. The sources found do not list AIclicks prompt allowances per tier, so the tiers are compared by price. Check each vendor's live page.

title: SEO content optimization cost by monthly articles
note: Surfer Essential $99 for 30 articles and Scale $219 for 100 (monthly billing; annual is about 20% less), with about $4 per extra article (one source). Frase Solo $15 (about 4 articles), Basic $45 (about 30 articles) and Team $115 (3 users, unlimited); the article limits come from third-party reviews. Scalenut's current Starter ($59), Plus ($89) and Professional ($199) plans cover GEO articles and prompt tracking rather than a fixed article count, so they are listed in the table but not modelled. USD only.

title: Bulk content: Writesonic plans vs AirOps tasks
note: Writesonic monthly prices checked August to November 2026: Starter $99 (15 AI articles), Basic $249 (25), Growth $499 (50); annual billing is about 20% lower; above 50 articles the calculator extends Growth at about $10 per article (Enterprise is custom). AirOps from $49 plus about $9 per 1,000 extra tasks (moderate confidence; the allowance of the $49 plan is assumed to be 1,000 tasks). The two tools do different jobs, so this compares tool fees only and excludes editing time.

title: AI presentation tool cost by team size
note: Per-seat prices billed annually, checked September to October 2026: Gamma Plus $9 and Pro $18; Beautiful.ai Team $40 (2 to 20 seats; $50 billed monthly); Canva Pro $144 a year per person (about $12 a month, or $18 billed monthly) and Canva Business $250 a year per person. Canva shares a monthly pool of AI credits across its Magic Studio tools (500 on Pro), Gamma Plus includes 1,000 credits and Pro 4,000, and Beautiful.ai includes unlimited AI generation. Tome shut down its presentation product on April 30, 2025 and is not included.

title: AI avatar video cost by minutes produced
note: HeyGen Creator $29 monthly (600 credits, about 19 minutes of Avatar IV video; about $1.50 per extra minute at that rate). Synthesia Starter $19 monthly (about 22 minutes) and Pro $89 (about 114 minutes, derived from published credit rates). Argil Classic $39 (about 25 minutes), Pro $149 (about 100) and Scale $499 (about 300), per Argil's plan documentation; extra minutes beyond Scale use its per-minute rate. Credit systems differ by avatar engine, so compare minutes on the engine you will use. HeyGen's allowance differs between sources.

title: Lead enrichment credit cost
note: Clay Launch $185 per month (about 2,500 Data Credits; top-up credits cost 50% above the plan rate, about $0.11 each). Apollo Basic $49 per user (about 2,500 credits a month) and Professional $79 (about 4,000), annual billing; the price of extra Apollo credits is an assumption at the Professional plan rate. Credits per lead depend on your workflow (on Apollo an email is 1 credit and a phone number 8).

title: Voice generation cost by audio hours
note: ElevenLabs Creator $22 (about 2 hours of audio), Pro $99 (about 11 hours) and Scale $299 (about 33 hours); overage about $0.18 per 1,000 characters on Pro (sources differ). Cartesia Pro $5 (about 1.9 hours), Startup $49 (about 23 hours) and Scale $299 (about 148 hours), at one credit per character. Fish Audio's pay-as-you-go API charges $15 per million UTF-8 bytes for its S2 Pro model, and OpenAI's gpt-4o-mini-tts is about $0.015 per minute of audio. One audio hour is about 54,000 characters (sources range from 45,000 to 83,000). Prices checked July to November 2026. Play.ht was reported shut down on December 31, 2025.

title: No-code app builder cost by prompts per month
note: Plan prices checked November 2026: Replit Core $20 (includes $20 of usage credits), Lovable Pro $25 (100 credits), Bolt Pro $25 (10M tokens). The cost per build prompt is an assumption because each tool meters differently: about $0.30 per Replit checkpoint, 1 Lovable credit, and 50,000 Bolt tokens. Overage rates for Lovable and Bolt are assumptions.

title: Real estate lead response: manual vs AI workflow
note: WhatsApp list rates for India checked 2026: marketing template about 0.86 rupees ($0.011), utility and authentication about 0.115 rupees ($0.0014); since October 1, 2026 Meta also charges service replies at the utility rate after 1,000 free per business number each month. Business solution provider fees and GST are extra. The $0.045 per lead assumes one marketing template plus five replies (about $0.018 of Meta fees) and about $0.027 of model usage (six exchanges on Claude Sonnet 5.5), plus a $9 Make Core plan. Staff time is an assumption you enter.

title: Invoice data entry: manual vs automated
note: Staff time is an assumption you enter. The automated workflow is a $9 Make Core plan plus about $0.01 per invoice of model usage (about 2,000 input and 500 output tokens at $2/$10 per 1M). Error rates and review time are not included.

title: Architectural renders: AI workflow vs traditional 3D studio
note: AI workflow: Midjourney Standard $30 a month (15 fast GPU hours, about 900 images, extra fast time $4 an hour) plus Magnific Premium $20 a month (20,000 credits, about 222 Precision 2K upscales at 90 credits each, extra credits about $1 per 1,000), checked October to November 2026. It assumes about 10 generations per final render. Traditional studio: a published starting price of $300 for a residential exterior still (ArchiCGI, October 2026); studios charge from about $300 to $2,800 per image.

title: Repurposing Shorts into blog posts: manual vs automated
note: Your time is an assumption you enter. The automated workflow is a $9 Make Core plan plus about $0.03 per post of model usage (about 2,000 tokens in and 2,000 out at $2/$10 per 1M). Editing time is not included.

title: Support cost: human only vs AI agent
note: Intercom's Fin AI Agent is priced at $0.99 per resolved conversation with a 50-resolution monthly minimum (published rate checked November 2026). The $4 cost per human-handled ticket is an assumption; enter your own.

title: GEO tracker cost by monitored prompts and engines
note: Otterly Lite $29 (15 prompts), Standard $189 (100), Premium $489 (400), with engine add-ons of about $9 each beyond four. Peec Starter $95 (50), Pro $245 (150), Advanced $495 (350); each engine beyond three costs $30 or more (the calculator uses $30). SE Ranking Core $129 plus the $89 AI Search add-on ($218) is assumed to cover 200 prompts and five engines; SE Ranking does not publish prompts for the add-on and sources differ. Beyond top tiers the calculator uses each plan's cost per prompt. Billed monthly, checked October to November 2026.

title: Team AI research stack cost and API breakeven
note: ChatGPT Business and Claude Team standard seats are $25 billed monthly ($20 annual) with a 2-seat minimum; Perplexity Enterprise Pro is about $40 per seat (checked November 2026). The pay-as-you-go option uses Perplexity's Search API at $5 per 1,000 requests plus Claude Sonnet 5.5 at $2/$10 per 1M tokens to write answers (assumes 3,000 input and 500 output tokens per search) over 22 working days. Subscriptions include apps and usage limits that an API stack does not.

title: Custom SEO calculator build cost: AI workflow vs developer
note: Claude Pro $20, Calconic Regular $17 per month (its free plan allows 5 calculators) and Outgrow from about $14 to $95 per month are published prices checked in 2026. Time per calculator, your hourly value ($20) and the freelance developer rate ($40 per hour) are assumptions; replace them with your own. The no-code builder option uses Calconic.

title: Solopreneur browser AI stack cost estimator
note: Monica Pro $99 a year (about $8.30 a month) and HARPA AI Individual $12 a month billed annually; Perplexity Pro and Claude Pro are $20 a month each (checked 2026). The free option is a built-in browser assistant with feature and usage limits. The cost per hour saved uses the hours you enter and 4.33 weeks a month.

title: Programmatic SEO traffic, AdSense and affiliate forecaster
note: These are assumptions, not a forecast. AdSense assumes a $10 RPM (earnings per 1,000 visits) and affiliate value assumes 2% of visitors click, 2% of those buy, and $18 of commission in the first month. Overhead assumes $15 of hosting plus $0.10 per page a month. Real RPM, click rates and conversion vary widely, so change these in Lab Settings.
